same_byte_path_control.test:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$dir=$PSScriptRoot
$stable=(Resolve-Path 'build/.ninja/x64').Path
$decision=Get-Content 'build/t28-package/s1-uwp-publish-01/result.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$paths=@('run16s.exe','ntw16s64.dll','ntwshk64.dll')
$backup=(New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $dir 'stable-previous')).FullName
foreach($name in $paths){
    $from=Join-Path 'O:/winnt' $name
    $target=Join-Path $stable $name
    $row=$decision.files|Where-Object {$_.path -ieq [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($from)}
    if(!$row -or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $from).Hash -ne $row.expected){throw "Unverified release module $name"}
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $target -Destination $backup
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $from -Destination $target -Force
    if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $target).Hash -ne $row.expected){throw "Staged comparison hash mismatch: $name"}
}
$env:PATH="$stable;$env:PATH"
$env:UWP_TEST_PUBLISHED_DLL=Join-Path $stable 'ntw16s64.dll'
$scan='Microsoft.WindowsScan_8wekyb3d8bbwe!App'
$calc='Microsoft.WindowsCalculator_8wekyb3d8bbwe!App'
$probe=Join-Path $dir 'uwp-settled-observer.exe'
$launcher=Join-Path $stable 'run16s.exe'
$matrix=@(@($probe,'--command-2k',$launcher),@($probe,'--app-command-2k',$launcher,$scan,'ScanApp.exe'),
    @((Join-Path $dir 'uwp-debug-global.exe'),$calc,'CalculatorApp.exe','pair-switch-2k',$scan,'ScanApp.exe'))
# The instrumented dispatcher normally runs all three path options. The compiled executable itself runs one selected path.
$codes=@(foreach($here in $matrix){python -c "import subprocess,sys;raise SystemExit(subprocess.run(sys.argv[1:],timeout=65).returncode)" @here|Out-Host;$LASTEXITCODE})
@{same_candidate_bytes=$true;results=$codes}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content (Join-Path $dir 'path-compare-result.json')

bounded_session_integration.selection_rule:
# Current desktop run of audited owned-window cases only.
    # Frame-target modes listed here send messages only to their own windows.
    $localFrame = '^ntw2ks-(frame(-fixed|-resize|-fixed-menu|-resize-menu|-aware-fixed|-aware-resize)?|startup-size|style-transition|caption-added|zoom-cycle-(default|aware)|resize-(natural|cycle)-(default|aware)|default-icon|tool(-resize)?|commands|capture-loss|button-order|disabled-commands|button-cancel|help-button|system-icon|custom-hit|geometry(-bare)?|scroll-geometry|menu-transition)-x(86|64)$'
    $known = @('progress-sharing','plan-selection','abi-x86','abi-x64','demo-boundary','automatic','propagation','creation-contract','rollback','process-lifecycle-x86','process-lifecycle-x64')
    $selected = @($cases | Where-Object {
        $_.name -cin $known -or
        ($_.name -like 'ntw2ks-*' -and $_.command -ne $dialogDriver -and
          !@($_.arguments | Where-Object { $_ -match '^--(private|low-private|physical)' }).Count) -or
        ($_.command -eq $dialogDriver -and $_.name -cmatch $localFrame -and
          $_.arguments[0] -eq '--direct' -and @($_.arguments -like '*ntw2ks-frame-target.exe').Count -eq 1 -and
          !@($_.arguments | Where-Object { $_ -match '^--(private|low-private|physical)' }).Count)
    })
    $selectedNames = @($selected | ForEach-Object name)
    $plan=@{coverage='bounded-session-integration';requested=@();omitted=@($cases | Where-Object { $_.name -cnotin $selectedNames } | ForEach-Object name)}
    $cases=$selected
    $FullIntegration=$false
    @{selected=$selectedNames;omitted=$plan.omitted}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4|Set-Content (Join-Path $scratch 'selection.json') -Encoding utf8
